_about: Eduard Zeller (1814-1908) in English, tr. Oswald J. Reichel (1840-1923). Classical scholarship (lane B pivot of 2026-10-10 from translations to public-domain English scholarship on the classics): The Stoics, Epicureans and Sceptics, clean Gutenberg. Round du (2026-10-23), raw IA: the rest of Zeller's Philosophy of the Greeks in English, all Longmans: A History of Greek Philosophy to the Time of Socrates (2 vols, tr. S. F. Alleyne, 1881), Socrates and the Socratic Schools (tr. Reichel, 3rd ed. revised, 1885), Plato and the Older Academy (tr. Alleyne and Alfred Goodwin, new ed., 1888), Aristotle and the Earlier Peripatetics (2 vols, tr. B. F. C. Costelloe and J. H. Muirhead, 1897), A History of Eclecticism in Greek Philosophy (tr. Alleyne, 1883), and the Outlines of the History of Greek Philosophy (tr. Alleyne and Evelyn Abbott, 1886). Not taken: his theological works (Strauss and Renan, The Contents and Origin of the Acts), which belong to the divines lanes. No uids minted.
